answer: Identity bonds decay: every agent locks a bond that loses 5% each epoch unless it does real, attested work. Bonds sit on a basalt-hard base layer, recorded in an onyx-black public ledger no identity can hide from. A violet signal flags bonds topped up from one funding cluster. Making 100 fakes costs 100 bonds bleeding value daily; honest agents pay once and earn it back through work. Fakes must keep refilling or fade; honest agents stay cheap.
